Thank you for offering hardware! Donated hardware is used to test and validate
arc-rebar on more GPUs and platforms.

**Please describe the hardware only.** Do not post your name, address, phone
number, email or any other personal details in this issue; it is public. We will
follow up to arrange shipping and other details privately.

- Type (graphics card / complete system / motherboard / other):
- Make and model:
- Condition (working / partially working / untested):
- Anything known about it (for example: no Resizable BAR option in BIOS, server board, dual-GPU capable):

- Country or region only (for shipping feasibility):
- Anything we should know about shipping (size, weight):
